titulo: Artworks stolen from Renoir Museum on French Riviera in latest heist
cuerpo: Thieves took four artworks but dropped one as they fled, says mayor of Cagnes-sur-Mer Two thieves have broken into a museum dedicated to the French impressionist painter Pierre-Auguste Renoir in southern France, stealing four artworks and dropping one as they fled. “This morning, two individuals broke into the Renoir Museum and stole four works of art,” said Bryan Masson, the mayor of Cagnes-sur-Mer.
